    External MCP Server Catalog - Sweep Log¶

    Every discovery pass behind the external MCP server catalog, newest first. Each entry records what the mcpservers.org and mcp.so surfaces returned, which candidates were measured, and what was held and why.

    🆕 November 23, 2026 - Night Sweep (4 New, 4 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 03:00 MST tick, 5.6 hours after the evening pass stored its baseline at 04:24Z. The directory added 204 slugs and removed none, a wave concentrated in one map, while the queue carried twenty-seven arrivals and the feed four cards. Four products shipped, and each one prices something an operator otherwise guesses at: a tax rate on a date, a climate match between two towns, a delivered total in won, and a data stream's own inventory record.

    • Avanciq MCP - VAT Rates and Invoice Checks With Receipts - a feed card at 09:53Z, seven minutes before the read. Six tools, no auth. A German rate returns 19.0 standard and 7.0 reduced with the TEDB source, source_read 2026-11-12 and a receipt id; an invoice claimed at 119.90 is called incorrect against 119.99 with a -0.09 difference reproduced by hand; 250,000 at 4.49 percent over 365 days returns correct at 11,225; and the free coverage tool publishes 71 jurisdictions served, 30 not covered and the call price of every metered tool.
    • Climatch MCP - A Climate Match for Any City You Pick - submission #7870 plus a sitemap arrival at /servers/climatch-co-agents. Nine keyless tools over 31,000 towns on TerraClimate 1991-2020: Lisbon at 28.3 C in August and 680 mm a year, Austin against Medellin a 6 match at 869 versus 2,482 mm of rain with both annual figures reproducing as exact monthly sums, London adjusted warmer returning Saint-Nazaire and Nantes at 87, and Napa returning hardiness zone 9b with wine grapes at 100 rainfed. weather_for_the_money is advertised and returns no data.
    • Moa MCP - Korean Prices Compared With Shipping - submission #7872, twelve keyless Korean tools. 16,677 tumblers, ten shown with price, shipping and total on one line, 3 stale prices flagged and a cursor for the rest; one comparison link across three domestic and two overseas sellers; and the defect that matters, where the cheapest wireless-earbuds answer was a 1,700 won cleaning brush, so the delivered-total logic is right and the relevance is not.
    • STRATA MCP - Sealed Data Streams Priced Per Call - a feed card at 06:01Z, 118 tools over sixteen Japanese business-data streams. The free floor is an inventory probe that returns a sealed record (checkCount 6, changeCount 3, firstSeenAt 2026-11-07, lastCheckedAt 2026-11-23T05:02:42Z, a Merkle root and a Rekor batch dated 2026-11-23), and the paid floor refuses cleanly at 0.006 USDC a call over x402 with an Apify event and an API key as alternatives.

    Also identified this pass (not catalogued). The wave decomposes into 12 Apify actor slugs, 67 documentation or marketing mirrors, 51 namespaced repository slugs and 74 plain product slugs, of which four were reached and the rest are named as not reached rather than dispositioned. Named for the next pass: cheap-gpus-com-mcp on the FinOps class, contextbolt-com-seo on the SEO and AI-visibility class, llmdocs-dev on docs retrieval, invohub-app-connect-quickbooks as an accounting connector, the abigaildavised five as prior dispositions re-entering under namespace slugs, and the domainvet, linkvet, utilvet and livedproof quartet as one author's pages fleet. Held from the queue and the feed with the gate or class named: the HenryCrawl ten (#7860 to #7869) and the mambalabsdev five (#7873 to #7877) on standing transport and fleet rulings; Zero-Proxy MCP Suite (#7884) as six Apify Standby endpoints behind one bearer key; Flowmingo (#7885) at 401 with a missing-credential challenge; Conqueror (#7882) at 401 invalid_token with a protected-resource document on the SEO class; past.dev (#7880) with a 401 account server beside a keyless three-tool documentation server, on the memory class; Reddit MCP (#7879) on social data; Nanobananana (#7881) on media generation; geolith (#7859) at 401 missing_api_key on geocoding; Phation (#7883) as local stdio; Browsa (#7871) on browser automation; OpenSubtitles (#7878) measured keyless and healthy at seven tools, held on the media and transcript class rather than refused on access; pagesmith-ai at 404 on /mcp and 401 with read write deploy at the bare host; and memory-fit at 401 in front of 107 tools over wearable health data.

    🆕 November 22, 2026 - Evening Sweep (3 New, 3 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 21:00 MST tick, eleven hours after the midday pass. The directory moved six canonical slugs and the queue carried twenty-two arrivals; the union key set rose 21 with 0 removals, of which fifteen were locale forms of one remote slug. Three products shipped, and each one answers with a number: which questions a company asks, what a listing costs and who is registered as the seller, and what margin a label sheet expects.

    • TrueInterview MCP - Interview Questions by Company and Round - submission #7837, registry published fifty seconds before the filing. 41 tools over company intel, a question bank by company, type and difficulty, a job feed and an application tracker; initialize and tools/list answer 200 keyless, four tools/call requests answer 401 with a twelve-scope challenge and a 200 protected-resource document, and the submission's claim that four tools work without signing in is recorded as measured false.
    • EX & GO MCP - Ukraine Classifieds With Seller Registration - submission #7842, MIT client repo, a read-only public door with no auth beside the OAuth door. 45 categories on the Google Merchant Center attribute vocabulary, 242 electronics listings over 11 pages, 10 results for iphone, and a record at 698 UAH in Kyiv whose trader block publishes a registration number, a declared address, selfCertified: true and verified: false as separate flags. Names in ten languages; two defects recorded.
    • LabelQueue MCP - Label Sheet Geometry Before the Print - a sitemap arrival, four keyless tools. Avery 5160 at 3 x 10 = 30 labels with a 2.75 in pitch and a 0.1875 in left margin, L7160 at 3 x 7 = 21 on A4, a 4 x 6 thermal roll at 812 x 1218 dots on 203 dpi, and print-drift diagnosis that names Fit-to-Printable-Area; three defects recorded, the worst being a silent 5160 default for any unknown code.

    Also identified this pass (not catalogued). Six canonical sitemap slugs and twenty-two queue arrivals were dispositioned. From the sitemap: rentcast-api-mcp and squish-mcp-server are the 2026-11-21 feed cards arriving under canonical slugs, orla-mcp was catalogued on 2026-10-08, imperal-mcp belongs to a feed card whose domain does not resolve and is held on developer tooling, irm-mcp-server answered 405 in plain text and is recorded unattributed, and the getyoutubetext transcript server joins the transcript class already holding four guides. From the queue: Agitech Site Check was driven keyless (overall 92, speed 84, search 74 for corpusiq.io on real query data) and held as a third-party copy of our own SEO and AI-visibility surface; MofCloud Pricing was driven keyless (15 tools, 1,102 H100 offers, GCP spot at 1.0881 USD per GPU-hour) and held on the FinOps class carried by OpenCloudCosts, Costory, Infrawise, GPUFinder and CoreHu GPU Cloud; PaperLesson, BaziTools, MassageInChina and OboeLib are four items of one author's five-item fleet on consumer reference verticals, with PaperLesson's initialize instructions string carrying a mcprush.com directory tag; Stratos and Sonjari are local stdio apps; marketingapp.io and tracee are social publishing; Eval Lab is agent evaluation; llmdocs.dev is docs retrieval; WDI is a local decision checklist; U.S. Market Regime, Monk.trade and MetricRaven are held on the saturated stock-research and analytics classes; BOTVBOT is entertainment; Telmian SMS and qurl are communications and tunneling; Kontext returns 401 at initialize on the OAuth gate; todox is agent memory; certified-mail-sender is print and mail; proofage is identity; wrapflow is app generation; greencyclepedia is reference content; and skaldmaps is the ZIP and place-ranking slice already held by four guides.

    🆕 November 22, 2026 - Midday Sweep (5 New, 5 Guides)¶

    Fired on the 10:00 MST tick, the first pass after the night sweep. The directory added no products: the union key set moved by one entry, a remote form of a slug already held, and the +139 raw <loc> entries were a re-shard inside five maps (servers/12 +201, servers/1 -36). Material came from the queue and two feed cards. All five that shipped state a price, a date or a deadline before anything is bought or sent.

    • FaxUp MCP - Send a Fax to 62 Countries From Chat - submission #7833, nine keyless tools and the first fax entry here. send_fax never sends: it returns a confirmation link. 62 countries; find_agency_fax_number("IRS") returns eight numbers split by state across two CAF units with the source and a 2026-11-12 check date; a three-page quote is $2.99 with packs from 5 for $3.99 to 100 for $39.99.
    • Fox Davidson MCP - UK Property Finance Calculators - a feed card. Fifteen keyless UK calculators. Stamp duty at GBP 450,000 returns 12,500 in England and 17,750 in Scotland for a first-time buyer, both reproducible from the returned bands. A buy-to-let stress test reproduces three ways (11,225 at 4.49%, 13,750 at the 5.5% stress rate, ICR 1.50 and 1.22) and names the loan ceiling that passes: 210,658 at 145% ICR. Market rates carry a reviewed date of 2026-11-18.

The legal posture is stated by the vendor and worth keeping: CBP has ruled that an unlicensed platform suggesting codes beyond six digits for goods to be entered is conducting customs business, an importer may classify its own goods, and the free tools serve the sources while the paid classifier is labelled guidance rather than a binding ruling.     • MeiSIM MCP - Phone Lines an Agent Can Own - hosted Streamable HTTP at https://mcp.meisimusa.com/mcp, keyless handshake as meisimusa-mcp 0.3.5 on protocol 2025-06-18, sixteen tools of which six answered with live data and six returned the server's own 401. The product is a real US mobile line, not a VoIP number: get_ai_line_offer priced it at 35 dollars a month per line for texts and 45 with SIP voice, falling to 32 and 42 at 10 lines, 29 and 39 at 50 and 25 and 35 at 200, on a two month minimum paid up front, with no refunds once a number is delivered. search_us_numbers returned 28 prepaid plans across five carriers from 7.50 to 288, every row carrying includes_us_number, and the price ceiling held at both bounds tested (10 returned two plans topping out at 10.00, 25 returned nine topping out at 21.00). search_plans returned 58 Japan, 80 France and 86 US eSIM plans from eight suppliers (Airalo, Sparks, 3, Bouygues, NextLink, RoamVault, IIJ, MeiSIM), cheapest 5.99, 4.70 and 5.99, and an empty list with no error for a country with no coverage. get_quote totalled 7.50 with zero tax and fees and expired in exactly 15 minutes, measured twice. wait_for_message blocks up to 50 seconds for the next inbound text, which is the tool a verification flow actually needs. The access model is the finding: every account tool answers a 401 that names both routes in and then states that a person opens the account, an AI agent cannot open the account by itself, behind a robot check and a government ID, so the agent buys, provisions, reads and replies while a human passes identity. Three defects recorded rather than smoothed: purchase requires a payment_method object whose own description says it is not used, search_plans refuses a call that omits duration_days while presenting data_gb as the optional filter, and a purchase mis-call returns two validation failures concatenated into one message with no field separator. First entry here for a phone line an agent owns, beside Mobile Text Alerts for broadcast SMS and WhatsApp Business for the Meta messaging platform.

Eleven calls were driven and the arithmetic was re-done by hand as a control: 3,000 clicks from 100,000 impressions against 3,150 from 125,000 over two 28-day periods returned clicksAtPriorCtr 3,750 modelled, an impressions component of +750 calculated, a CTR component of -600 calculated and an observed click delta of +150, and the two components add back to the delta. The finding is the refusal: Google's impressions-logging anomaly runs 2025-05-13 to 2026-04-27, and a comparison touching it returned value: null with nullReason: "GSC_REPORTING_ANOMALY" on every impressions-dependent figure - both CTRs, the impression delta, the percentage-point change, the relative change, both modelled figures and both components - while clickDelta stayed +200 observed and the anomaly was listed with Google's own sourceUrl. check_gsc_reporting_issues returns the registry behind that behaviour, two records with their effects (block_ctr_diagnostics and warn). Three bad inputs were refused with machine-readable codes (PERIOD_LENGTH_MISMATCH, PERIOD_OVERLAP, CLICKS_GT_IMPRESSIONS); the defect recorded in the guide is that those refusals arrive as HTTP 200 with structuredContent.errors and no content block, so a client rendering only content shows nothing, and two observed figures come back unrounded.

    Integration with CorpusIQ¶

    CorpusIQ is the connector layer that lets AI assistants read the systems a business already runs on - accounting, payments, CRM, email, files and analytics - and answer with the source named. It is read-only by design: it retrieves data and never writes to, or acts in, a connected system, which is what makes it safe to point at live accounts.

    This page is part of the CorpusIQ directory, the reference we maintain for the MCP server and agent-skill ecosystem. Run alongside CorpusIQ, a third-party server like this one can be combined with a company's own business data in a single answer.
